prior_semantics: Static-route relFlow share of the direct landing among the vehicles that the group decision sends to the two branches of one off-ramp group (direct / signal connector of the lane plant off_groups offramp_route_inventory_v1). evaluation/controllers/offramp_routing.derive_prior re-derives it from the pinned network and refuses a mismatch. It replaces the per-signal code default {SC1001: 0.468, SC1004: 0.484} (a realised 30-decision average of an older network) by an exogenous value per group (user decision 2026-09-25: relFlow values, realised shares only for validation).
